consumer: The pickup path's too-heavy branch, which must present the player an interactive wear/wield/skip choice answered through the engine's real active input loop.
scope: An interactive prompt/menu offered at the too-heavy moment, driven through the real input mechanism so the player's wear/wield/skip selection is consumed by the engine's own input dispatch.
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::weight_capacity — computes a single carry-capacity mass number from strength, mutations, enchantments, worn items, and bionics; it neither presents the choice nor drives any too-heavy decision through the input loop.
divergence: A character with the DEBUG_STORAGE trait returns units::mass_max, so the capacity number reports effectively infinite capacity and the too-heavy choice never fires; conversely two characters with identical weight_capacity but different worn/wield eligibility get the same number, which cannot distinguish wear vs wield vs skip — the choice the goal actually requires.
